_about: Official EUROAVIA Ideathon 2026 Ansys bracket set-up, written 2026-11-05 from the organisers' card (Ideathon_Challenge_Ansys_2026.docx) and CAD (Eurovia Challenge 2026 CAD file.dsco, geometry measured in derived/features.json). Interpretation choices are marked [Y] in setup/boundary_conditions.md. Hole ids follow aerokit.bracket.features ordering (axis, then centre); check them against the first bracket_day.py hole scan before use. | v2 (5 Nov 13:10): non-design regions per industrial TO practice — base skin kept (one continuous mounting flange ties both lugs and all 4 bolts), lug eyes kept to the ORIGINAL edge distance (e = 61.4 mm above the pin), bolt bosses Ø105 through the plate; see setup/TO_v2_method.md | v3 skeleton: base skin NOT frozen; symmetry x/y; FoS on yield; one-body gate
name: EUROAVIA 2026 cowling-support bracket (initial S275N design)

load_cases.name: LC1a Fz+97 kN, Fy+24 kN each pin
LC1b Fz+97 kN, Fy-24 kN each pin
LC1c Fz+97 kN, Fy +24/-24 kN (opposite, sensitivity)
LC2 My 2000 N m (1000 per pin bore)

non_design._about: v3 skeleton (5 Nov ~14:00, user: 'freezing the base is wrong, X braces can do it'): ONLY the functional interfaces are frozen — bolt bosses r 30 -> 52.5 mm (ISO 7089 M56 washer OD 105) over z 30-100 and lug eyes r 30 -> 61.4 mm (original edge distance). The plate region is free design space; one-body is a RESULT gate (pipeline rejects a layout of more than one body), not frozen material. | 14:05 user: the requirement is that the two LUGS are connected -> a frozen minimum-section tie (2 x 2 voxels = 15.6 x 15.6 mm) on the symmetry plane x = 500 at the top of the plate (z 84-100), y 30-371.12, joining both lug roots (~0.3 kg). The optimiser may thicken it and add braces; the clevis gap at pin height stays free (outside the design domain). | 14:10: the tie is now generated by the rule features.load_ties (connect_loads), identical mask (6237 elements) to the 14:03 box

design_criteria._about: card: FoS 1.5 on yield at working temperature (>300 C) [Y: applied as vM_max*1.5 <= Fty(300 C)]; max displacement < 1/400 of largest dimension (661.01 mm -> 1.653 mm) | 5 Nov ~13:45 mentor: FoS 1.5 preferably on YIELD -> strength_basis 'yield' (U = 1.5 sigma / Fty(T))

_symmetry_about: auto: features.detect_symmetry finds the mirror planes from the holes, supports and load set (x 500, y 200.09 for the official set-up; identical voxel groups to the 14:03 run with x 500 / y 200.28)
